claim_scope: Corrected checkpoint-and-demand-paging candidate only; do not pool with canonical Claude A/B cells or use v1-v6 judge scores for the primary architecture claim.

v6_exclusion.reason: v6 was structurally valid but failed both primary performance gates. Fixed Sol scoring was 141/217 (64.98%) versus isolated upstream Mike at 150/217 (69.12%), while provider-reported total tokens were 1,745,096 versus 1,436,478 (+21.5%). Real traces showed that direct drafting Grep calls over exact source ranges already contained in the reviewed mounted union were misclassified as new durable evidence, causing redundant checkpoint and drafting-handoff cycles. Its scores remain cost and behavior diagnostics only.
v6_exclusion.policy: Keep v6 and its fixed-judge scores as diagnostics; v7 must be run and inspected independently before scoring.

v7_general_correction: Index exact document/version/source ranges and provider-reference bytes in the reviewed mounted evidence union.

During drafting, mark a direct reread as durable-union-backed only when its complete original-source range and projection, or its stable provider handle and exact bytes, are already represented by the reviewed mounted union.

Keep such rereads visible to the fresh drafting-context guard while excluding them from durable-union deltas, so they cannot spuriously reopen checkpointing. Partial ranges, new projections, new handles, and evidence outside the union remain new research and still require checkpoint review.
Tell drafting to use the reviewed checkpoint as a coverage checklist and explicitly disposition every material finding, contradiction, number, unresolved question, and next action.
Record gross reviewed-union reread calls and source characters in trace and run telemetry.
dynamic_fingerprint_policy: Each run must record exact resident/checkpoint/drafting system-prompt hashes, tool-schema hashes, task/source hashes, harness-source hashes, configuration, and composite run SHA-256. The three cells must share task-independent prompt/tool variants and differ only where source/task content is part of the prompt.

run_policy.launch: Launch all three candidate performers concurrently after this file is written, parsed, and its source hashes are rechecked.
run_policy.inspection: Inspect tool calls/results, reviewed-union reuse, checkpoint compression and continuity, checkpoint-to-handoff hashes, working-set pages, context rounds, service tier, tokens/cache/latency, receipts, and evaluator-readable DOCX artifacts before scoring.
run_policy.invalidity: Reject a cell for incomplete checkpoints, checkpoint/handoff hash mismatch, over-cap handoff/page, missing exact union, answer-text DOCX fallback, non-default reported tier, tool failure that compromises the deliverable, missing fingerprints, or unreadable deliverables.

judge.temperature_policy: Retry without temperature only for the exact unsupported-temperature provider rejection.

acceptance_gate: Under the fixed Sol judge, v7 must score at least 150/217 in aggregate and use fewer than 1,436,478 aggregate provider-reported total tokens against the freshly reproduced isolated-upstream cells; accuracy and valid deliverables come first, with context, per-task tokens, latency, coverage, and tool behavior reported afterward.
